links.outcome: ACS diagnostic accuracy of LLMs versus human experts on same retrospective chest pain data
links.effect: Human experts 86.37% accuracy and 89.26% specificity vs Lingyi Zhihui 76.40%/70.15%, Tongyi Qianwen 61.11%/47.95%, MediGuide-14B 84.52% accuracy; LLMs had higher sensitivity.
links.quote: Human experts achieved higher accuracy (86.37%) and specificity (89.26%) but lower sensitivity compared to the LLMs.

screen.reason: Retrospective comparative evaluation of LLMs versus human experts for emergency chest pain triage on electronic medical record data, without testing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
